summary: Build scalable systems, distributed infrastructure, and high-throughput backend services powering Google Search and Cloud services.
raw_text:
Role: Software Engineer (SWE)
Company: Google LLC
Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, build, deploy and maintain high-performance, fault-tolerant distributed systems in C++, Java, or Go.
- Apply deep knowledge of Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) to optimize low-latency data pipelines and compute services.
- Architect scalable systems with clean Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and modular microservice boundaries.
- Debug complex concurrency, multithreading, and memory bottlenecks across Linux Operating Systems (OS).
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, participate in rigorous code reviews, write automated unit/integration tests, and adhere to SWE best practices.
- Build resilient cloud-native services leveraging GCP, containerization, and networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/2, gRPC).

What We're Looking For:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Proficiency in C++, Java, Go, or Python (COD).
- Proven problem-solving ability with advanced algorithms, dynamic programming, and complexity analysis (DSA).
- Experience designing distributed systems (SYSD), high availability architectures, and caching layers.
- Strong grounding in Operating Systems (OS) concepts: process scheduling, threads, virtual memory, and POSIX APIs.
- Familiarity with Cloud architectures (GCP/AWS), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines (SWE).
- Effective verbal and written technical communication skills (COMM).

summary: Develop advanced machine learning algorithms, causal inference frameworks, and statistical models on planet-scale datasets.
raw_text:
Role: Data Scientist
Company: Google LLC
Location: Bengaluru, India

Key Responsibilities:
- Formulate business and product questions into mathematical, statistical, and Machine Learning (AI) problem formulations.
- Build, train, validate, and deploy end-to-end deep learning and LLM foundation models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Python (COD).
- Query, transform, and aggregate terabyte-scale distributed data stores using advanced SQL and distributed compute frameworks (BigQuery, Spark).
- Conduct rigorous A/B experiments, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal inference modeling (APTI).
- Collaborate with Software Engineering (SWE) and product teams to translate model outputs into production infrastructure.
- Present insights, data narratives, and model performance metrics clearly to cross-functional leadership (COMM).

What We're Looking For:
- Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related quantitative field.
- Expert Python coding (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn) and strong SQL data analysis skills.
- Deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI), supervised/unsupervised learning, NLP, transformers, and neural network optimization.
- Strong aptitude (APTI) in mathematical reasoning, probability, linear algebra, and multivariate statistics.
- Hands-on experience with cloud-based machine learning pipelines (GCP Vertex AI, AWS SageMaker) (CLOUD).
- Solid software engineering practices: version control (Git), reproducible experimentation, automated evaluation (SWE).

summary: Design and engineer resilient enterprise cloud services and scalable distributed platforms on Azure.
raw_text:
Role: Software Engineer
Company: Microsoft Corporation
Location: Hyderabad, India

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and maintain highly available cloud microservices using C#, TypeScript, Java, or C++ (COD).
- Architect enterprise-grade distributed systems on Microsoft Azure (CLOUD), utilizing Kubernetes, Azure Functions, and Event Hubs.
- Apply Object-Oriented Design (OOD) principles, clean architecture patterns, and domain-driven design.
- Implement comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, and telemetry monitoring (SWE).
- Optimize relational and distributed NoSQL databases (SQL Server, CosmosDB, PostgreSQL) for high-concurrency workloads.
- Partner with PMs, architects, and designers across international time zones to deliver world-class developer experiences (COMM).

What We're Looking For:
- B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- Solid coding skills in C#, C++, Java, or modern TypeScript/JavaScript (COD).
- Proficiency in Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA): search, trees, graphs, sorting, and algorithmic efficiency.
- Hands-on expertise in Cloud computing (Azure or AWS), containerization (Docker), and microservices architecture.
- Strong understanding of System Design (SYSD), event-driven architectures, rate limiting, and asynchronous queuing.
- Practical database design (SQL), schema normalization, and query performance tuning.
- High standards of Software Engineering (SWE): code reviews, refactoring, and automated deployment.

summary: Drive business intelligence, telemetry analysis, and executive dashboarding across Microsoft product ecosystems.
raw_text:
Role: Data Analyst
Company: Microsoft Corporation
Location: Hyderabad, India

Key Responsibilities:
- Author performant SQL queries, stored procedures, and ETL pipelines to extract and process telemetry from multiple enterprise databases (SQL).
- Design dynamic, interactive executive reporting dashboards and KPI scorecards using Power BI, Excel, and Tableau.
- Perform exploratory data analysis, trend identification, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics using Python or R (COD/AI).
- Apply statistical aptitude (APTI) to analyze customer retention, user funnels, telemetry logs, and adoption metrics.
- Translate ambiguous stakeholder requests into crisp analytical requirements and communicate data stories effectively (COMM).
- Maintain data governance, data cataloging, and automated data quality validation pipelines (SWE).

What We're Looking For:
- Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or related discipline.
- Mastery of SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, indexing, and partitioning).
- Analytical problem-solving aptitude (APTI) and quantitative reasoning.
- Practical Python programming (COD) with Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn for statistical data wrangling.
- Proven experience with Power BI or enterprise BI visualization suites.
- Excellent stakeholder communication and presentation skills (COMM).

summary: Develop and enhance core banking transaction engines, payment gateways, and enterprise financial software suites.
raw_text:
Role: Associate Software Engineer
Company: Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS)
Location: Bengaluru / Mumbai, India

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop, customize, and maintain core banking and financial solutions using Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, and PL/SQL (COD/SQL).
- Build robust relational database models, write complex stored procedures, triggers, and query optimizations in Oracle Database (SQL).
- Apply Object-Oriented Design (OOD) patterns, dependency injection, and modular service contracts.
- Ensure strict compliance with financial regulations, security standards (TLS/SSL, OAuth2), and data transaction integrity (ACID).
- Write automated unit tests using JUnit/Mockito, participate in sprint ceremonies, and manage code via Git (SWE).
- Integrate financial messaging protocols (ISO 20022, SWIFT) and RESTful web services across secure networks (NETW).

What We're Looking For:
- B.E. / B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or relevant degree.
- Solid core Java programming skills (collections, multithreading, exception handling) (COD).
- High proficiency in relational databases and SQL / PL/SQL (tables, views, indexes, query plans) (SQL).
- Good grasp of Object-Oriented Design principles (OOD) and design patterns.
- Strong aptitude (APTI) for financial math, logical flowcharts, and edge-case handling.
- Basic understanding of Unix/Linux OS commands and shell scripting (OS).
- Team player with clear technical and interpersonal communication skills (COMM).

summary: Provide tier-2/3 production support, incident triage, SQL data patching, and Linux batch monitoring for global banking clients.
raw_text:
Role: Application Support Analyst
Company: Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS)
Location: Bengaluru / Chennai, India

Key Responsibilities:
- Monitor and troubleshoot 24x7 mission-critical banking applications, batch end-of-day (EOD) processing, and transaction interfaces.
- Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on production incidents, triage system errors, and execute verified SQL data fixes (SQL).
- Write and run Unix/Linux shell scripts, automate recurring maintenance jobs, and monitor server resource utilization (OS).
- Track incidents, change requests, and service requests using Jira and ServiceNow, adhering to strict SLAs.
- Verify network connectivity, API payloads, port status, and banking protocol handshake logs (NETW).
- Coordinate communications between bank client operations teams, software engineering, and infrastructure architects (COMM).

What We're Looking For:
- Degree in Computer Science, IT, BCA/MCA, or related engineering discipline.
- Strong working knowledge of SQL and Oracle Database (queries, updates, joins, troubleshooting locks) (SQL).
- Proficiency in Unix/Linux commands, shell scripting, and log inspection (grep, awk, sed, cron) (OS).
- High aptitude (APTI) for debugging, process flowcharting, and incident triage under pressure.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills (COMM) for client-facing and internal communication.
- Basic familiarity with networking concepts (DNS, TCP/IP, ping, traceroute, SSL certificates) (NETW).
- Disciplined approach to ITIL incident and change management workflows (SWE).
